scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed: consistent indigo accent threads through badge, brushes, and sparkline bars; clean typographic hierarchy and card layout; but Tableau10 palette for region lines is canned and the dense 150-line tangle creates visual noise at rest.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Parallel-coord axes correctly use d3.extent (non-zero baseline is appropriate here) and sparkline bar charts honestly start at zero, but histogram bin count is hardcoded at 24 rather than derived via Sturges'/Scott's rule, and foreground sparkline bars lack key functions (positional identity works only because bins are always regenerated in order).
scores.stress_test_note: Both the brush 'brush' event (line 417) and the strum 'pointermove' handler (line 359) call updateSelection() → drawLines() + full DOM-mutating updateTable() on every mousemove frame with no requestAnimationFrame coalescing, dirty flag, or debounce.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Canvas opacity layering (unselected at 0.1 gray, selected at 0.85 color) and a restrained 6-color Tableau palette manage 150-line density well, but the initial unfiltered state renders all lines in full color simultaneously, burying regional structure until the viewer brushes an axis.
